basis.observed: ForeverDB loot src=seen, quality>=2, equipment inventory slot; no drop rates or inferred role rankings
basis.published: Explicit boss/item table in a Forever guide, with exact item identity and separately fetched client/catalog metadata. Does not establish observed drops or exhaustive loot.
basis.localization: Existing translations preserved. Added RU strings only from exact item IDs in https://foreverdb.net/data/search/ru.json; other proper names retain source spelling.
basis.unknownRequiredLevel: 0 is the existing missing-value sentinel, displayed as a dash; not a claim that a level-zero character can equip an item.
